title: Re-audit mock pages against the product model success criteria
goal: Once the cleanup passes are finished, every page in the study needs checking again against the six things the product vision says a person must be able to do. Anything still falling short becomes its own piece of work rather than being noted and forgotten.
notes:
Objective: creation-vision (gated: run after the conform pass and entries pass). From study-tasks.json reaudit. Run shared/ux-audit-agent.md across all pages against the 6 PRODUCT-MODEL.md success criteria; feed misses back into the queue until clean. Do after the conform pass and entries pass.

Stage-gate drop 2026-08-24. Re-verified before dropping so it can be re-filed
when creation-vision is staged now.

Gating deps are satisfied: finish-the-mock-conform-pass-across-all-pages is
done (2026-08-23T06:35Z) and blank-slate-entry-clickthrough-per-surface-on-on
is done (2026-08-23T07:14Z), so acceptance item 3 ("run after the conformance
and entry passes") would be met if the epic were in focus.

CORRECTION for re-filing: the rubric is TEN criteria, not six. This task and
its acceptance were imported when PRODUCT-MODEL.md §5 held six; it now reads
"A refine pass is good when all ten hold" (docs/design/mocks/shared/
PRODUCT-MODEL.md:378-411): 1 one model written down, 2 shell coherence,
3 legible entries, 4 one walkthrough template, 5 foundation-gated features,
6 the build test, 7 responsive & collapsible, 8 history-first preserved,
9 every screen declares its kind, 10 walkthroughs are one app operated.
The goal and acceptance both say "six" and must be rewritten to "ten" on
re-file, or the audit will silently skip criteria 7-10 (which is where the
long tail of real misses lives).

The work is genuinely not already done. docs/design/mocks/ux-audit-2026-08-23.md
(259 lines) is the most recent audit, but it is organized by the seven
conformance clusters A-G from shared/ux-audit-agent.md, not by the rubric:
grep for "success criteri", "criterion" and "rubric" across
ux-audit-2026-08-23.md and ux-audit-clusters.md returns zero hits. It also
predates the entries pass. So there is still no per-page pass/fail matrix
against the rubric, which is acceptance item 1.

Scope on re-file: 90 pages under docs/design/mocks/pages/ (up from the 88 the
last audit covered) x 10 criteria. Tools already in place: shared/ux-audit-
agent.md (the audit prompt), shared/audit-sweep.js (the browser measurement
sweep that covers criterion 7, reported 88/88 clean on 2026-08-23),
shared/check-selection.mjs, shared/check-states.mjs, shared/check-elevation.mjs.
Existing open findings live in audit-findings.json (330 lines) and
ux-audit-clusters.md; the re-audit should dedupe against those before filing
new tasks so the same F/G long-tail items are not filed twice.
acceptance: A findings file records a pass or fail for every page against each of the six success criteria
Every failure is filed as its own queue task, with none left unfiled
The audit is run after the conformance and entry passes have landed, not before
